name: Yep Anywhere Self-Hosted Agent UI
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted browser interface for existing Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions, including mobile approvals, session management, file/diff review and notifications; no software seat quota or expiry stated.
watch_out: Requires user-provided machine, Node.js and installed/authenticated Claude Code or Codex CLI. Agent subscriptions or API usage are not included and may cost money. Optional public relay is third-party infrastructure; direct self-hosted access requires secure networking and authentication. Desktop installers are beta.
